label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Share a little story in your emails
body: Connecting through personal anecdotes helps your audience feel closer to you and your brand.
caption:
People love stories! When you share a brief, relevant story in your emails – maybe about a challenge you faced, a small win, or how an idea came to life – it makes your content more relatable and memorable. It’s a simple way to build a stronger connection with your audience, making your emails something they look forward to reading. Think about a small story you can share this week. 😊
